Ingest_LDD.name: Operations
Ingest_LDD.comment: The purpose of the Ops LDD is to define operational and supplemental metadata for PDS4 products, including file, access, processing provenance, lifecycle, validation, and usability metadata that supports registry, API, search, and delivery services but does not belong in archival product labels.

DD_Attribute.name: producer
DD_Attribute.definition: The organization or entity that produced the product.

DD_Attribute.name: steward_organization
DD_Attribute.definition: The top-level organization responsible for stewardship, curation, or long-term management.

DD_Attribute.name: steward_sub_organization
DD_Attribute.definition: The organizational unit within the steward organization responsible for stewardship, curation, or long-term management.

DD_Attribute.name: file_role
DD_Attribute.definition: Identifies whether the file is a PDS4 label or a data file.

DD_Permissible_Value.value_meaning: The file is a PDS4 label file.
The data file described by a PDS4 label.

DD_Attribute.name: mime_type
DD_Attribute.definition: (Definition not provided — replace with an authored definition.)

DD_Attribute.name: access_uri
DD_Attribute.definition: (Definition not provided — replace with an authored definition.)

DD_Attribute.name: access_available
DD_Attribute.definition: Indicates whether the resource at this URI is currently available.

DD_Attribute.name: authorization_required
DD_Attribute.definition: Indicates whether authorization is required to access the resource at this URI.

DD_Attribute.name: access_method
DD_Attribute.definition: (Definition not provided — replace with an authored definition.)

DD_Permissible_Value.value_meaning: The URI is accessed via HTTPS.
The URI is an Amazon S3 URI or compatible object-storage URI.
The URI is a native or system-local path.
The URI is intended for internal operational use only.

DD_Attribute.name: representation_role
DD_Attribute.definition: Identifies the role of this file representation in relation to the product.

DD_Permissible_Value.value_meaning: The primary representation of the product.
A browse or preview representation.
An alternate representation of the product.

DD_Attribute.name: representation_profile
DD_Attribute.definition: Identifies the intended deployment purpose or optimization of this file representation.

DD_Permissible_Value.value_meaning: The file is optimized for user download and delivery.
The file is optimized for cloud-based processing and access.
The file is in a format suitable for long-term archival retention and is the designated preservation copy.

DD_Attribute.name: compression_algorithm
DD_Attribute.definition: (Definition not provided — replace with an authored definition.)

DD_Attribute.name: parent_bundle_identifier
DD_Attribute.definition: The logical identifier of the parent bundle that contains or aggregates the product.

DD_Attribute.name: parent_collection_identifier
DD_Attribute.definition: The logical identifier of the parent collection that contains or aggregates the product.

DD_Attribute.name: registry_membership_complete
DD_Attribute.definition: Indicates whether all expected members of an aggregate product are present in the registry. True indicates complete membership; false indicates that one or more expected members are missing or not linked.

DD_Attribute.name: registry_membership_evaluation_date_time
DD_Attribute.definition: The date and time at which registry membership completeness was last evaluated.

DD_Attribute.name: version_status
DD_Attribute.definition: The class Version_Status optionally records that a product version has been superseded or withdrawn. This class is intended for these exceptional cases and should be omitted for current product versions.

DD_Permissible_Value.value_meaning: The product version has been replaced by a later version and is no longer the current version.
The product version has been withdrawn from general use or distribution.

DD_Attribute.name: version_status_date_time
DD_Attribute.definition: The date and time at which the version status was assigned or last updated.

DD_Attribute.name: harvest_id
DD_Attribute.definition: The identifier assigned to the harvest activity associated with the product.

DD_Attribute.name: harvest_date_time
DD_Attribute.definition: The date and time at which the product was harvested.

DD_Attribute.name: harvest_version
DD_Attribute.definition: The version of the harvesting software used to harvest the product.

DD_Attribute.name: harvest_source
DD_Attribute.definition: Identifies the source from which the product was harvested.

DD_Attribute.name: harvest_job_identifier
DD_Attribute.definition: The identifier assigned to the harvest job that processed the product.

DD_Attribute.name: harvest_profile_identifier
DD_Attribute.definition: The identifier of the harvest configuration profile used to process the product.

DD_Attribute.name: registry_id
DD_Attribute.definition: The URI that identifies the product record in the registry.

DD_Attribute.name: registry_version
DD_Attribute.definition: The version of the registry record associated with the product.

DD_Attribute.name: registry_sweepers_ancestry_version
DD_Attribute.definition: The version of the Registry Sweepers ancestry process applied to the product.

DD_Attribute.name: registry_sweepers_repairkit_version
DD_Attribute.definition: The version of the Registry Sweepers repair kit applied to the product.

DD_Attribute.name: derived_from_identifier
DD_Attribute.definition: The identifier of a source product containing input data used in the creation of the described product. The source product may be within or outside the PDS4 Registry. External source products should be documented consistently with the PDS Source_Product_External class.

DD_Attribute.name: systems_lifecycle_phase
DD_Attribute.definition: (Definition not provided — replace with an authored definition.)

DD_Permissible_Value.value_meaning: The product is being planned, generated, documented, packaged, or otherwise prepared by a data provider for submission to PDS for archive or operational handling.
The product is being transferred from a data provider to the PDS for acceptance, harvesting, loading, and registration.
The product is undergoing operational, technical, or approval review.
The product has been prepared for release and is staged in an operational system but is not yet publicly available online.
The product is made available through an operational release workflow. When systems_lifecycle_state = complete, the product is publicly available online.
The product has been taken offline and is no longer publicly available through operational systems.

DD_Attribute.name: systems_lifecycle_state
DD_Attribute.definition: (Definition not provided — replace with an authored definition.)

DD_Permissible_Value.value_meaning: The lifecycle phase has not yet started.
The lifecycle phase is currently underway.
The lifecycle phase cannot proceed until an issue, dependency, or decision is resolved.
The lifecycle phase has been completed.
The lifecycle phase did not complete successfully.

DD_Attribute.name: status_date_time
DD_Attribute.definition: (Definition not provided — replace with an authored definition.)

DD_Attribute.name: status_message
DD_Attribute.definition: (Definition not provided — replace with an authored definition.)

DD_Attribute.name: archive_lifecycle_state
DD_Attribute.definition: (Definition not provided — replace with an authored definition.)

DD_Permissible_Value.value_meaning: The product has not yet entered the evaluation process.
The product is undergoing an internal evaluation before formal peer review.
The product is currently undergoing formal review for archival acceptance.
Review has identified issues or liens that are being resolved.
The product has successfully completed archive evaluation and has been publicly released through the archive.
The product did not satisfy requirements for archival acceptance.

DD_Attribute.name: archive_quality
DD_Attribute.definition: (Definition not provided — replace with an authored definition.)

DD_Permissible_Value.value_meaning: The product satisfies archive quality requirements.
The product requires additional work before meeting archive quality requirements.
Product quality is indeterminate and is not intended for formal inclusion in the PDS archive and may be made available externally to the archive.
Archive quality has not yet been determined.

DD_Attribute.name: accumulating_data_flag
DD_Attribute.definition: Indicates whether the product is accumulating under the PDS Policy on Accumulating Data. True indicates that data are being delivered incrementally at intervals mutually agreeable to the data provider and the PDS node. False indicates that the product was accumulating but the final increment has now been ingested. When the attribute is absent, the product is not designated as accumulating.

DD_Attribute.name: archive_status_date_time
DD_Attribute.definition: The date and time at which the archive status was assigned or updated.

DD_Attribute.name: archive_status_message
DD_Attribute.definition: Free-text notes describing archive status.

DD_Attribute.name: validation_state
DD_Attribute.definition: (Definition not provided — replace with an authored definition.)

DD_Permissible_Value.value_meaning: The product passed the validation assessment.
The product failed the validation assessment.
The product passed validation but produced one or more warnings.
The product has not been validated.
The validation result is not known.

DD_Attribute.name: validator_name
DD_Attribute.definition: The name of the validation tool, service, or application used to perform the validation assessment.

DD_Attribute.name: validator_version
DD_Attribute.definition: The version of the validation tool, service, or application used to perform the validation assessment.

DD_Attribute.name: validation_date_time
DD_Attribute.definition: The date and time at which the validation assessment was performed.

DD_Attribute.name: validation_message_text
DD_Attribute.definition: A human-readable description of a validation result, warning, or error generated during validation.

DD_Attribute.name: action_required
DD_Attribute.definition: Indicates whether the validation assessment identified issues requiring corrective action.

DD_Attribute.name: pds4_version_id
DD_Attribute.definition: The PDS4 version identifier associated with the namespace.

DD_Class.name: Operation_Metadata
DD_Class.definition: The class Operation_Metadata is the top-level class for operational and supplemental metadata associated with a PDS4 product.

DD_Class.name: Stewardship_Info
DD_Class.definition: The class Stewardship_Info describes the organizations responsible for producing and stewarding a product.

DD_Class.name: File_Info
DD_Class.definition: The class File_Info describes deployed or operational characteristics of a PDS4 label or data file.

DD_Class.name: Access_Info
DD_Class.definition: The class Access_Info describes a URI and its access characteristics for a file. Each instance represents one URI at which the file can be accessed.

DD_Class.name: Product_Ancestry
DD_Class.definition: The class Product_Ancestry describes aggregation or membership relationships between a PDS4 product and its parent aggregate products.

DD_Class.name: Version_Status
DD_Class.definition: The class Version_Status identifies the operational standing of a product version.

DD_Class.name: Processing_Provenance
DD_Class.definition: The class Processing_Provenance captures Engineering Node operational provenance generated during harvest and registry activities for a product.

DD_Class.name: Systems_Lifecycle_Status
DD_Class.definition: The class Systems_Lifecycle_Status captures the current operational state of a product within the Engineering Node operational workflow. The lifecycle phase identifies where the product is in the workflow, while the lifecycle state identifies the state of activity within that phase. When systems_lifecycle_phase = available and systems_lifecycle_state = complete, the product is publicly available online.

DD_Class.name: Archive_Lifecycle_Status
DD_Class.definition: The class Archive_Lifecycle_Status captures the state of a product, collection, or bundle within the PDS archival review, preparation, and release lifecycle.

DD_Class.name: Validation_Assessment
DD_Class.definition: The class Validation_Assessment captures the result of validating a product against a specified information model, schema, schematron, local data dictionary, or validation tool.

DD_Class.name: Validated_Against
DD_Class.definition: The class Validated_Against identifies a PDS4 information model namespace and version used during a validation assessment.

DD_Class.name: Label_File_Info
DD_Class.definition: Extension of File_Info for the label_file_info role. (Extension class auto-generated by yaml2ingestldd — replace with an authored definition.)

DD_Class.name: Data_File_Info
DD_Class.definition: Extension of File_Info for the data_file_info role. (Extension class auto-generated by yaml2ingestldd — replace with an authored definition.)

DD_Class.name: Validated_Against_Core
DD_Class.definition: Extension of Validated_Against for the validated_against_core role. (Extension class auto-generated by yaml2ingestldd — replace with an authored definition.)

DD_Class.name: Validated_Against_Ldd
DD_Class.definition: Extension of Validated_Against for the validated_against_ldd role. (Extension class auto-generated by yaml2ingestldd — replace with an authored definition.)

DD_Rule_Statement.rule_message: OPS:error:ops:operation_metadata_not_empty: Operation_Metadata must contain at least one child element. Omit the class when no operational metadata is provided.
